description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractIndelUpdate' that implements the 'IndelUpdate' interface, representing a generic update operation with insert and delete sets, along with a replace-all flag. It provides methods to modify and access these sets, as well as overridden methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: AbstractIndelUpdate
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the IndelUpdate interface, managing sets of insert and delete operations with a replaceAll flag, providing core functionalities.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the insert and delete sets to empty and sets replaceAll to false.

methods.name: getInserts
methods.description: Returns the set of insert elements.

methods.name: getDeletes
methods.description: Returns the set of delete elements.

methods.name: shouldReplaceAll
methods.description: Indicates whether the update should replace all existing elements.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds an element to the inserts set and removes it from deletes if present.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds an element to the deletes set and removes it from inserts if present.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on inserts, deletes, and replaceAll flag.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on inserts, deletes, and replaceAll.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the update, including inserts, deletes, and replaceAll.
